behaviors_asserted: The jsx.tsx example from honojs/examples works without compiler options.
Adding the second pragma /** @jsxImportSource hono/jsx */ causes deno to error with: "Relative import path \"hono/jsx/jsx-runtime\" not prefixed with / or ./ or ../".
Using the compiler configuration suggested by the docs causes a similar "Relative import path \"hono/jsx/jsx-runtime\" not prefixed with / or ./ or ../" error at a different location.
The documentation at https://hono.dev/guides/jsx suggests adding a second pragma or using a compiler configuration, but those suggestions lead to deno import-path errors while the example does not.
